subjects.title: Repository topology and ownership
subjects.purpose: Defines the split documentation, API, SDK, and app surfaces; records source/documentation ownership and the repository-identity contradiction.

subjects.title: SDK integration and public API
subjects.purpose: Defines the supported public integration boundary: `@class-kit/react`, client construction, ProductProvider, public namespaces, and the prohibition on direct browser database/RPC access.

subjects.title: Product access and authentication
subjects.purpose: Defines product resolution from origin/site URL, auth modes and providers, redirect configuration, product access states, membership activation, and their gate precedence.

subjects.title: Access gates and state contract
subjects.purpose: Enumerates the auth-mode, provider-availability, product-access, and product-user state contracts, including the precedence of origin resolution, identity, eligibility, membership, and approval gates.

subjects.title: Authorization and product roles
subjects.purpose: Defines platform/product membership separation, level and permission-key guards, built-in and custom roles, role assignments, and dashboard capability derivation.

subjects.title: Classes and registration lifecycle
subjects.purpose: Defines customer class discovery and detail, concrete-class publication/cancellation lifecycle, registration approval/rejection/cancellation, and capacity/membership policy ownership.

subjects.title: Class and attendance state contract
subjects.purpose: Enumerates class visibility and cancellation, registration transition, stale-pending cleanup, and attendance lifecycle contracts with their user-visible outcomes.

subjects.title: Operational class delivery
subjects.purpose: Defines management workflows for classes, templates, schedules, attendance, and public signup links, including schedule and attendance states.

subjects.title: Memberships and product-user records
subjects.purpose: Defines membership modes, grant/set/upgrade/revoke and stock outcomes, customer self-profile behavior, manager metadata replacement, and product-user roles.

subjects.title: Entitlement and schedule state contract
subjects.purpose: Enumerates membership modes and grant outcomes plus schedule recurrence, status, skip, and generation eligibility contracts.

subjects.title: Product documents and change requests
subjects.purpose: Defines anonymous document reads, active-user acceptance snapshots, managed document versions, change-request revisions/statuses, attachments, and soft deletion.

subjects.title: Document and request state contract
subjects.purpose: Enumerates document publication/archive and acceptance-retention behavior plus request revision, deletion, status, and PM-sync outcomes.

subjects.title: Platform administration and PM integration
subjects.purpose: Defines product provisioning, origins and auth redirects, platform/user access operations, role control plane, product truncation, and Trello request synchronization.

subjects.title: Deployment and release operations
subjects.purpose: Defines product-scoped local and remote Supabase deployment, destructive-reset restrictions, static-host private SDK access, and SDK release ownership.
